id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

calcFieldPath.description: Field path for the calc field represented by this entry

calcPeriod.description: The calc period specified if the field is a periodic calc

calcPeriodInvalid.description: True if the specified calc period for the field is invalid.  Refresh will be skipped.

calcSchedule.description: The calc schedule specified if the field is a scheduled calc

calcScheduleInvalid.description: True if the specified calc schedule for the field is invalid.  Refresh will be skipped.

calcScheduleComplete.description: True if the specified calc schedule doesn't indicate any further refreshes.  Refresh will be skipped.

lastRefresh.description: History entry for the last time the field was refreshed

nextRefresh.description: The next time the field will be refreshed based on when it was last refreshed and its defined period or schedule

validationError.description:
If the entry fails validation for any reason, the associated error message.  If this field is not null, processing
will be skipped for this entry until it is corrected.

history.description: Refresh history for the calc field

title:
Maintains the state of all calc fields designated as either `periodic` or `scheduled`.  Each entry will represent
a single periodic or scheduled calc field and its id will be a "safeId" based on the qualified field path for the
field.
name: PeriodicCalcState
